description: Before the Cataclysm, you were lucky in some way.  Maybe you never lost your keys, or maybe you always made that last green light before getting home, or maybe you never had to take a sick day in your life.  Now after the Cataclysm, you have the potential for even more power.  Your first attempt to awaken psionic powers will always be successful.
You can tolerate others, but you prefer to be alone.  Spending time by yourself will boost your mood slightly.
//: Unimplemented effects, no need to show in starting menu, staying for EoC purposes

description: You'd really rather be by yourself.  Being alone will improve your mood, but spending too much time around other people can grate on your nerves.
//: Unimplemented effects, no need to show in starting menu, staying for EoC purposes

description: Thanks to your powers, you need less food and drink than the average person and are more efficient at processing it.
You've seen people do some crazy things after the Cataclysm, but you've never managed to figure out how they do it.  You can never learn psionic powers.
You're a disembodied mind so you're all glowy and blue.  Spooky!
Gazing into the near future lets you know what part goes where.

Your powers protect you from some sensory disruption and allow you to detect creatures from beyond.
Your powers help protect you from electrical damage and slightly reduce the intensity of pain you feel.
You have a matrix in your central nervous system that acts as a universal control and installation bus for compact bionic modules.

You were born in the Ēxcān Tlahtōlōyān, maybe on Tlalticpactli, perhaps even in Anáhuac, or maybe on one of the colony worlds like Demeter or Yathrib or Tài Suì.  You enlisted in the Imperial Navy for your own reasons.  Perhaps you are a scion of the Huey Calpulli following in your ancestors' footsteps, or perhaps you are one of the mācēhualtin seeking the social benefits of a completed tour of military service.  Regardless, now you are here, in the ashes of a dying world, and have to find a way to survive.

description: You have a hard time remembering things.  Your skills will erode slightly faster than usual, and you have trouble keeping your story straight when lying.
//: Unimplemented effects, no need to show in starting menu, staying for EoC purposes

description: You have an exceptional memory, and find it easy to remember things.  However, you don't benefit as much as other people from dropping a subject for a while and will thus end up learning slower.
//: Unimplemented effects, no need to show in starting menu, staying for EoC purposes

description: Reading is for nerds!  Boring books are more boring, and you can't have fun by reading books.
You managed to awaken psionic powers, but it was a struggle and you're not sure you'll be able to do it again.  You are subject to the random odds of awakening new powers.
You can't bear to stay still for long.  Your morale will suffer unless you constantly explore new territory.
Spending any amount of time in familiar places makes you miserable.  Must.  Keep.  Moving.
Your ability to feel or express emotion has been greatly hampered.
You can make the air around you emit a strong light.

transform.msg_transform: The air around you starts glowing brightly.

description: Your powers passively filter the amount of photons your eyes receive, and amplify what little light there is -- you see well even in near-total darkness.
You're a very picky eater.  You refuse to eat any food that tastes bad unless you're starving.
//: Unimplemented effects, no need to show in starting menu, staying for EoC purposes

description: You are capable of holding the same thing in mind even when sitting in an uncomfortable position or after skipping a meal.

description: You can maintain your concentration even if outside in winter without a coat or while in combat with a zombie.
//: proficiency modeled as a visible trait (port_traits CURATED_TRAITS)

description: You can maintain your concentration even when suffering crippling injuries or while on mind-altering substances.

description: You can take more time and care in channeling your powers.  It will take 5x as long to evoke them, but it will be much easier to activate them and you will be less likely to gain Nether Attunement while doing so.
The active trait for Extended Channeling.  It's a bug if you can see it.
You can draw deeply on the Nether, increasing the strength of your powers but making making them harder to initiate and control.
The active trait for Torrential Channeling.  It's a bug if you can see it.
The school trait for knacks.  It shouldn't be visible.

description: You naturally heat the air around you slightly, making it more comfortable in the cold.  It also helps prevent you from getting too wet.
The fire in your soul rises and falls, but never truly goes out.
You tend to have bouts of depression during the fall and especially winter.  Taking antidepressants can help.

Thanks to the crystalline elixir, you can lash out with unfocused surges of telekinetic power.
You are subtly influencing the minds of the people you speak to.
You can keep otherworldly eyes off you to some extent, and you will sometimes instinctively teleport to avoid danger.
When you try to tell a lie, you blush, stammer, and get all shifty-eyed.  Telling lies and otherwise bluffing will be much more difficult for you.

description: You know you're beautiful, and the world deserves to know it too.  You prefer to show off your stunningly good looks and will be unhappy if you cover up your face.
You're very strictly vegan, eating animal products is out of the question, even if it means death.  You also can't bear to wear clothing made of animal products, such as leather or fur.

description: Who needs weapons?  Thanks to your biokinesis, you deal more melee damage while fighting with your bare hands.  This damage improves as your unarmed skill and biokinetic prowess increase.
Your psionic powers speed your healing slightly and increase your overall resilience, and any broken limbs you have mend straight and true.
